prompt: Plan §17 topic 6 (cross-asset regime features; registered shelf verdicts: Autotrader Plan §20.14-§20.15 — cite them, do not re-derive the sources): a breadth-gated exposure overlay on the standard 17-pair USDT universe: BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, BNB/USDT, XRP/USDT, ADA/USDT, SOL/USDT, DOGE/USDT, LTC/USDT, LINK/USDT, XLM/USDT, TRX/USDT, AVAX/USDT, ALGO/USDT, UNI/USDT, NEAR/USDT, HBAR/USDT, ZEC/USDT. Crypto translation of the equity regime feature set: market breadth = the share of the 17 names trading above their own trailing 100-day mean close. Participation width is the one genuinely cross-asset regime feature expressible from the close panels today: there is no crypto credit proxy, and volatility-level ranking is the closed LowVolatility graveyard family. Construction, fixed a priori, never to be tuned: hold the equal-weight 17-pair basket while in risk-on; enter risk-on when breadth crosses above 0.5; exit to FULL CASH when breadth crosses below 0.3 (hysteresis so the gate does not chatter); timeframe 1d. NOT cross-sectional — it times the whole book, it ranks nothing. The trade unit is one regime episode: risk-on entry to cash exit of the entire book, so turnover_per_trade is honestly 1.0 and must not be set lower. Estimate discipline, learned from the LowVolRankTilt17 and DistanceFromHighs cards: state all three estimates at the episode trade unit; count episodes realistically from how often crypto breadth actually cycles through a 0.3/0.5 hysteresis band on a 100d feature (breadth regimes run months, not weeks — do not count daily bars as trades); credit the basket's market drift at ZERO, the claimed edge is only the avoided-loss differential versus holding the basket through risk-off phases, never bull-market returns; per-episode sd must reflect de-levering an entire basket of ~3.5-4% daily vol for a multi-week episode (sd well above the 0.15 that multi-week single-name holds carry is expected — do not shade it down). Kinship disclosure for provenance: the killed rehearsal toy DonchianBreakout17 was single-series breakout timing and the dead DistanceFromHighs family was per-name proximity-to-high; this card's mechanism is cross-asset participation width, a different feature, but it is still long-only de-levering logic and the card must say so. Suggested name: BreadthRegimeGate17.
